volume.tooltip: Speaker level (−∞…0 dB). 0 dB is unity. Default −3 dB. Old patches that stored 0…1 linear Volume are converted on load. Type a dB value (or −inf).

pan.tooltip: Stereo balance after Mono is summed in. 0 = unchanged (Mono to both). −1 = left only. +1 = right only.

mix.tooltip: Wet/dry balance for the reverb output.

recycle.tooltip: Feedback amount for the reverb tail.

seed.tooltip: Randomizes the delay line pattern. Same seed always reproduces the same reverb character.

mode.tooltip: Real-pole stacks. LP / HP use High Cut / Low Cut. BP is HP then LP. Old LP6/BP6/HP6 values stay 0/1/2.

slope.tooltip: Cascaded real 1-poles. 6 dB = one pole; 24 dB = four. No resonance.

stagger.tooltip: Pole spread ratio k. 1 = same freq; ~1.5 gentle spread; above ~2.2 a stair-step. No effect at 6 dB.

lowFrequency.tooltip: Highpass cutoff (HP and BP). Sweep moves this with High Cut in musical steps.

highFrequency.tooltip: Lowpass cutoff (LP and BP). Sweep moves this with Low Cut in musical steps.

sweep.tooltip: Shift used cutoffs in semitones. BP keeps the Low/High interval (ratio) constant.

gainCompensation.tooltip: On = scale poles so the labeled cutoff is −3 dB. Off = every pole sits on the staggered freqs. No effect at 6 dB.

interpolate.tooltip: Off = classic hold. Linear / Smoothstep glide from previous hold to the new sample over the clock period (Sample Freq) or last Clock interval. Applies to Ext and internal Left/Right.

polarity.tooltip: Bipolar = −1…1 (raw hold / noise). Unipolar = 0…1 remap for MOD into unipolar params (Frequency, etc.) without a B2U.

amplitude.tooltip: Scale Ext Out (and L/R). 0 = mute, 1 = full. Use instead of an external attenuverter for MOD depth.

rate.tooltip: Clock rate in Hz. Wired ƒ cancels Rate (absolute Hz), same as oscillators.

duty.tooltip: Gate high time as a fraction of the period. Quantized to whole samples at the current rate.

maxSeconds.tooltip: Longest wait between random triggers. Changing Min/Max remaps the current wait immediately.

triggerTime.tooltip: How long the Trigger output stays high. Gate length is Duty × this interval.

threshold.tooltip: Reset input rising-edge trip. When Reset crosses above this, a new interval is drawn and Trigger fires.

freqUpdate.tooltip: When ƒ changes mid-cycle: On cycle waits for wrap; Warp remaining keeps dither offset; Snap remaining re-dithers the remaining length.

waveform.tooltip: Cycle-dither AA oscillator (RS-MET). Saw = edge then down; Ramp = up then edge. Morph: Pulse = duty; Trisaw Center = opposing peaks toward saw; Analog Square = same-direction peaks (zeros at 0 / 0.5).

frequency.tooltip: Absolute Hz. Mid-cycle Hz changes warp the remaining period (phase-continuous).

phase.tooltip: Phase used when Reset is triggered (or on first sample).

morph.tooltip: Universal morph 0...1 (always Morph). Pulse = duty/width; Trisaw Center = opposing peaks lean triangle into a saw (zeros at 0 / 0.5; Morph 0/1 bright mirrors, 0.5 dullest); Analog Square = same-direction peaks (dual-edge / square-ish at extremes); other shapes ignore for now.

amplitude.tooltip: Linear output level 0…1 (guides only; MOD may exceed).

inputGain.tooltip: Drive into the limiter before detect/GR. Raise to hit Threshold harder (more pump).

threshold.tooltip: Level where gain reduction starts. Lower = more compression/pump on typical program.

ratio.tooltip: How hard GR climbs above Threshold. ~4–8 = firm. ~12–20 = heavy pump.

lookaheadEnabled.tooltip: On = delay audio so GR can fall before hits (helps pump without zero-attack chatter).

lookaheadMs.tooltip: Look-ahead delay in ms when Look-ahead is On. Part of the sound (not host-compensated).

lookaheadSamples.tooltip: Extra look-ahead in samples (added to LA Time). Hidden by default.

attack.tooltip: How fast GR engages on a hit. A few ms keeps punch while still pumping.

release.tooltip: How fast gain recovers after a hit — the main pump/breathe timing. Longer = slower swell back.

amplitude.tooltip: Final output trim after GR. 0…1. Lower if the bus is too hot; no autogain.

shape.tooltip: Analog = one-pole (classic). Linear / Smoothstep = stretch a 0…1 segment with that warp. No extra curve knobs.

attack.tooltip: Attack time. Modulatable. Gate↑ attacks from current level (no hard restart).

decay.tooltip: Decay time to Sustain × velocity. Modulatable.

sustain.tooltip: Sustain level (0…1), scaled by Gate velocity. Modulatable.

release.tooltip: Release time after Gate falls. Modulatable.
